source.attenuation_mapping: 0.02 * clip(1 + HU/1000, 0, 3) /mm; illustrative water scale, not energy-calibrated.
source.modification: Two axial slices retained as float32 HU; both in-plane axes reversed.
source.orientation: Rows and columns reversed from source: columns increase patient left; rows increase posterior.
source.preparation: Real CT image; simulated noiseless parallel projections. Original scanner projections are unavailable.
source.projection_integration: Bilinear source-grid sampling with midpoint quadrature at <= half source pixel pitch.
source.reference_sampling: 128 by 128 pixels, 4 by 4 subpixel averaging; same physical field of view.
source.title: Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver CT, distributed by 3D Slicer
